content: Root cause: The root cause of the bug was a Null Pointer Exception (NPE) that occurred when the `failedRemoveCinderDisks` variable was not properly initialized before attempting to add elements to it. In the original code, if an `InterruptedException` or `ExecutionException` was caught, the code attempted to add all elements from `cinderDisks` to `failedRemoveCinderDisks`, which was likely null at that point. The patch fixed this by assigning `cinderDisks` directly to `failedRemoveCinderDisks`, ensuring that it is properly initialized and preventing the NPE.

Root cause:
The root cause of the bug was a Null Pointer Exception (NPE) that occurred when the `failedRemoveCinderDisks` variable was not properly initialized before attempting to add elements to it. In the original code, if an `InterruptedException` or `ExecutionException` was caught, the code attempted to add all elements from `cinderDisks` to `failedRemoveCinderDisks`, which was likely null at that point. The patch fixed this by assigning `cinderDisks` directly to `failedRemoveCinderDisks`, ensuring that it is properly initialized and preventing the NPE.
Patch:
From 30394030106a6b78388ade892d1616bbce02f8a9 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Greg Sheremeta <gshereme@redhat.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Mar 2015 16:54:05 -0400
Subject: [PATCH] engine: fixed NPE findbugs introduced in 1bfc9d0

Change-Id: Ib125a84415d84b2d4cda661b04719b5f5fa470d8
Signed-off-by: Greg Sheremeta <gshereme@redhat.com>
---
 .../main/java/org/ovirt/engine/core/bll/RemoveVmCommand.java    | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/backend/manager/modules/bll/src/main/java/org/ovirt/engine/core/bll/RemoveVmCommand.java b/backend/manager/modules/bll/src/main/java/org/ovirt/engine/core/bll/RemoveVmCommand.java
index 0de4946a62b..a028e4ab465 100644
--- a/backend/manager/modules/bll/src/main/java/org/ovirt/engine/core/bll/RemoveVmCommand.java
+++ b/backend/manager/modules/bll/src/main/java/org/ovirt/engine/core/bll/RemoveVmCommand.java
@@ -349,7 +349,7 @@ public class RemoveVmCommand<T extends RemoveVmParameters> extends VmCommand<T>
             try {
                 failedRemoveCinderDisks = future.get().getActionReturnValue();
             } catch (InterruptedException | ExecutionException e) {
-                failedRemoveCinderDisks.addAll(cinderDisks);
+                failedRemoveCinderDisks = cinderDisks;
                 log.error("Exception", e);
             }
         }
